title: R' Elazar Nayota’ah (Yuchasin reads Nuza’ah or Shifa’ah)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Gittin 50a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.50a.12), in the form: “But did not R' Elazar Nayota’ah teach…”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Nayota’ah follows the vocalized form נָיוֹתָאָה in the William Davidson digital text of Gittin 50a. That witness names Rabbi Eliezer, whereas the supplied notice and heading have Elazar. The heading’s Yuchasin alternatives Nuza’ah and Shifa’ah are retained.

The linked Bavli reads Rabbi Eliezer Nayota’ah. Hyman and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=543&lang=en) have Elazar. Heilprin also records alternative spellings of the epithet. The translation retains Hyman’s given name and his reported Yuchasin readings.
